🚀 Executive Summary: The Active Pool (propAMM) Paradigm

Metric (metric.xyz / app.metric.xyz) represents a fundamental architectural departure from traditional automated market makers (AMMs). While conventional decentralized exchanges (such as Uniswap v2/v3, Curve, and Balancer) rely on passive mathematical invariant curves where prices only change when trades occur on-chain, Metric introduces Active Pools (propAMM).

By decoupling pricing from internal pool liquidity reserves and anchoring mid-market quotes directly to real-time external oracles (Pyth Network, Chainlink), Metric eliminates toxic LVR (Loss-Versus-Rebalancing) arbitrage and creates an institutional-grade trading engine tailored for tokenized equities ($NVDAB, $META, $SPCX, $QQQB), Real-World Assets (RWAs), foreign exchange (FX), commodities, and crypto majors.

⚙️ Key Concept — Bin Placement & Edge Auto-Compounding
In Metric's propAMM, liquidity is allocated into relative percentage bins rather than fixed dollar price ticks. As Pyth updates the mid-price, the bins automatically move with the market.
